body_lead: CHENNAI: Tamil Nadu has placed artificial intelligence (AI) at the centre of its industrial and governance strategy by swearing in a minister dedicated to the sector – potentially making it one of the few states to move towards a standalone AI Ministry. The swearing-in of Velachery MLA R Kumar as Minister for Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology and Digital Services marks the first concrete step towards implementing the TVK’s ambitious election promise to institutionalise AI governance across the state.
